# getHarsh

> Harsh Joshi builds products, explores intelligence and makes things, with AI since 2012.



- [About Harsh Joshi](https://getharsh.in/about/index.md): The curiosity, experiences and people behind my practice. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/about/))

- [From a model answer to a useful product](https://getharsh.in/blog/an-ai-product-is-more-than-a-model/index.md): Product judgment connects model behaviour to a user's task, the surrounding operation and a way to recover. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/an-ai-product-is-more-than-a-model/))

- [The vocabulary of an unfamiliar world](https://getharsh.in/blog/an-analogy-can-start-an-argument/index.md): A triangle, a clock and an operating-system image open questions that change as I follow them. What must a new vocabulary let us see? ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/an-analogy-can-start-an-argument/))

- [Sneak peek into infinity: the breath of cosmos and its duration](https://getharsh.in/blog/breath-of-cosmos/index.md): A breath opens a thought experiment in control systems, cosmic time and unbounded ratios, leading to the possibility of collective consciousness. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/breath-of-cosmos/))

- [Debauchery, in the name of existence!](https://getharsh.in/blog/debauchery-in-the-name-of-existence/index.md): A year-end provocation about solving problems, transferring their consequences and making room for compassion and unfamiliar ways of knowing. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/debauchery-in-the-name-of-existence/))

- [Dumb comedy: existentialism for the twenty-first century](https://getharsh.in/blog/dumb-comedy/index.md): Why sitcoms, their awkward heroes and the small pleasure of a joke gave me a way back into larger questions at the end of 2019. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/dumb-comedy/))

- [Every digital product manager must become an AI product manager](https://getharsh.in/blog/every-product-manager-is-an-ai-product-manager/index.md): Consumer empathy, technical fluency and research must meet when AI changes how people use a product and how a business delivers it. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/every-product-manager-is-an-ai-product-manager/))

- [Figuring things out, one book at a time](https://getharsh.in/blog/figuring-things-out-one-book-at-a-time/index.md): A February 2020 reflection on forgiveness, attachment, friendship and taking time to find the next part of a life. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/figuring-things-out-one-book-at-a-time/))

- [When the compute question became larger](https://getharsh.in/blog/from-compute-to-an-economic-question/index.md): Following useful AI capacity from a workload into the organisations and economic arrangements around it. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/from-compute-to-an-economic-question/))

- [Holding an idea without becoming it](https://getharsh.in/blog/holding-an-idea-without-becoming-it/index.md): Why detachment complements capitalism: hearing the objection, changing the plan and making room for work neither side could do alone. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/holding-an-idea-without-becoming-it/))

- [Blog](https://getharsh.in/blog/index.md): Essays that stand on their own, from leadership and product work to comedy, forgiveness and the scale of a breath. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/))

- [Knowing, understanding and realising](https://getharsh.in/blog/knowing-understanding-and-realising/index.md): Why possessing an explanation and making its meaning part of one's life are different encounters. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/knowing-understanding-and-realising/))

- [When customers need less product](https://getharsh.in/blog/making-a-product-smaller/index.md): Customer evidence can make removing complexity a stronger product decision than extending the feature list. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/making-a-product-smaller/))

- [Navigating the feedback loop](https://getharsh.in/blog/navigating-the-feedback-loop/index.md): How awareness, metadata and reusable intelligence connect a personal inquiry through YOJN, engineering, mathematics and Sleepwalker. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/navigating-the-feedback-loop/))

- [How research becomes a reading path](https://getharsh.in/blog/research-becomes-a-reading-path/index.md): An editorial programme connects a reader's problem to explanations, evidence and useful artifacts without turning each article into the same sales pitch. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/research-becomes-a-reading-path/))

- [Leading beyond the title](https://getharsh.in/blog/responsibility-is-not-a-title/index.md): The uncomfortable work of earning trust, making a decision and helping a team outgrow its dependence on you. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/responsibility-is-not-a-title/))

- [Teachings of the mirror](https://getharsh.in/blog/teachings-of-the-mirror/index.md): A Mahashivratri reflection on the teacher as a mirror, the difficulty of an unbiased encounter and the work of finding a path. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/teachings-of-the-mirror/))

- [Gravity was still acting on the magnet](https://getharsh.in/blog/the-first-decade/index.md): A first-decade reflection on the people, experiments and personal life that shape professional judgment. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/the-first-decade/))

- [The future we create, and condemn](https://getharsh.in/blog/the-future-we-create-and-condemn/index.md): A January 2020 reflection on a father and son imagining the same future, the economics of making it real and the identities that shape our response. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/the-future-we-create-and-condemn/))

- [Vision, strategy, agility and culture](https://getharsh.in/blog/vision-strategy-agility-and-culture/index.md): Why a plan needs time to understand the problem, room to change and a team whose trust carries more than a process can specify. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/vision-strategy-agility-and-culture/))

- [From the plant to the team](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/a-career-through-problems/from-the-plant-to-the-team/index.md): A measurement problem became a product problem, and then a problem of helping other people carry the work.
